answer_1.quote: The attended image, along with the original query, is then processed by an MLLM to generate the final answer.
answer_1.outputs: generated textual answers to visual document questions

answer_2.quote: We use Exact-Match (EM), F1-Score , and ANLS Score as automatic metrics to assess the correctness of the predicted answers.

answer_3.quote: To ensure scalable quality assessment, we employed Claude-3.5-Sonnet and Gemini-2.0-Flash as independent judges, achieving strong inter-model agreement.
methods: automated verification of generated QA pairs

answer_4.quote: We evaluate NiM-Benchmark using human performance, achieving 63% EM and 70% F1. ... human evaluation on 100 samples, with the assistance of three annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators assessed model answers using Exact Match and F1 criteria.
